g.text: The Annotation Discipline: Retain / Modify / Replace / Retire
Every Source-state module receives exactly one of four annotations from the custodians. The annotation becomes the parity contract.

The annotation discipline is governed: every Source-state module must receive an annotation before migration begins.
Modules that have not been annotated cannot enter the migration loop.
